dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about Kuutar...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar is the deity we Frostmoon Scions revere. Whatever we pray for, she answers. Whatever we seek, she guides us to find.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Because she is the merciful new moon, the successor of Frost Moon, and a god deserving of our praise. You should try praying to her too. Should your soul be pure enough, I'm sure she will respond to your pleas.
